name: spectral-delay
description:
A delay with a different time for the lows, the mids and the highs.

The echoes are made in the spectrum: each bin is delayed by a whole number
of blocks, and the feedback goes round inside the bin, so a band repeats
without ever leaking into the others.  A spectrum cannot be defined in
terms of itself, but its real and imaginary parts are bin signals, and
those can.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
